profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SP6
profile.summary:
Experienced full-stack Software Engineer and AWS Certified SysOps Administrator and Developer specializing in Cybersecurity and managing big data via Splunk.  Dedicated to building performant software that keeps organizations secure and CMMC compliant. Record of architecting software solutions that help maintain SP6's position as North America's top rated Splunk partner.

Current focus:
- AWS
- Python
- JavaScript & React
- Splunk 
- DevOps
- CMMC Compliance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
SP6 is a niche technology firm advising organizations on how to best leverage the combination of big data analytics and automation across distinct practice areas: 

* Cybersecurity Operations and Cyber Risk Management
* Fraud detection and prevention 
* IT and DevOps Observability and Site Reliability 

- CMMC Registered Practitioner (RP)
- Architecture, development, and maintenance of company IP
- Mentoring and teaching junior developers
- Custom Professional Services development of Splunk apps and add-ons 
- Develop internal automation solutions and web applications to streamline business processes
- AWS administration, provisioning of services, and application deployment  
- Architecture, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of SP6's customer-facing website
